topics.title: GDP and Economic Activity
keyFacts: GDP limitations: ignores inequality, informal economy, externalities, non-market activity

topics.title: AD-AS Model
keyFacts: AD shifts: C, I, G, NX changes
SRAS shifts: input costs, productivity, exchange rate
LRAS shifts: technology, labour force, capital stock

topics.title: Fiscal and Monetary Policy
keyFacts: Fiscal: government changes G or T
Monetary: central bank changes interest rates or money supply
Multiplier effect: ΔY = k × ΔG where k = 1/(1-MPC)

topics.title: Unemployment and Inflation
keyFacts: Short-run Phillips curve: inverse relationship between inflation and unemployment
Long-run: vertical at natural rate (expectations-augmented Phillips curve)
